description: A read-only SQL query on one of the project's PostgreSQL databases; format short (default; a cut response says how to read the rest), detailed (wider limits) or csv (an export).

database.description: Name of the database (databases[].name); the first declared by default.

limit.description: Row cap: short 200, detailed 400 (2,000 at most); csv 10,000 (50,000).

max_bytes.description: Byte limit: short 40 KB, detailed and csv 200 KB.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

name: query_database
title: Read a database with SQL
